bio_en: I am a PhD student in the Department of Microbiology, School of Life Sciences, Fudan University, with an expected graduation date of June 2029. My research combines AI foundation models, biological sequence representation learning and deep learning with viral evolution and genomic epidemiology. My experience includes nucleotide foundation-model benchmarking, protein language-model applications, computational model development and evaluation, and bioinformatics analysis workflows.
bio_zh: 我现为复旦大学生命科学学院微生物系博士研究生，预计于2029年6月毕业。研究结合AI大模型与基础模型、生物序列表征学习及深度学习，关注病毒进化与基因组流行病学。研究经历涵盖核酸基础模型评测、蛋白质语言模型应用、计算模型开发与评估，以及生物信息学分析流程构建。

experience.institution_zh: 上海睿昂基因科技股份有限公司
bullets_en: Developed analysis methods for BCL6, BCL2 and MYC gene fusions in DLBCL sequencing workflows, addressing discrepancies between NGS and FISH results.
Established low-depth whole-genome sequencing workflows for copy-number analysis using QDNAseq, Control-FREEC and ichorCNA.
Built upstream and downstream single-cell RNA-seq workflows and collaborated with IT colleagues to deploy analyses on an automated platform.
Developed RNA-seq expression-based models for leukemia molecular subtyping.
bullets_zh: 围绕弥漫大B细胞淋巴瘤测序中的BCL6、BCL2和MYC基因融合检测，开发分析方法，改善NGS与FISH结果的一致性。
搭建低深度全基因组测序拷贝数分析流程，整合QDNAseq、Control-FREEC和ichorCNA。
构建单细胞RNA测序上下游分析流程，与IT团队协作完成自动化平台部署。
基于RNA-seq表达谱开发白血病分子分型预测模型。

bullets_en: Conducted bioinformatics analyses of viral evolution and genomic epidemiology, with a focus on influenza and RSV.
Integrated genomic, clinical and immunological datasets and contributed to collaborative research publications.
bullets_zh: 开展病毒进化与基因组流行病学的生物信息学分析，关注流感与呼吸道合胞病毒（RSV）。
整合基因组、临床及免疫学数据，参与合作研究与论文发表。

ai_projects.name_en: AI foundation models and deep learning
ai_projects.name_zh: AI大模型、基础模型与深度学习
ai_projects.text_en: Research experience in nucleotide foundation-model benchmarking and protein language-model applications. Co-developed computational models and training frameworks, curated datasets, performed benchmarking and model evaluation, and prepared research manuscripts.

research_intro_en: My projects connect foundation models and deep learning with biological sequence analysis, genomic epidemiology, transcriptomics and cancer genomics.
research_intro_zh: 研究工作围绕基础模型与深度学习、生物序列分析、基因组流行病学，以及转录组与肿瘤基因组数据分析展开。

research_projects.meta_zh: 深度学习 · 生物序列表征
research_projects.summary_en: UniCAV is a computational research project applying sequence representation learning and deep learning to the analysis of HIV-1 neutralization data. The work brings together model development, data curation and comparative evaluation.
research_projects.summary_zh: UniCAV将序列表征学习与深度学习用于HIV-1中和数据的计算分析，研究工作涵盖模型开发、数据整理与比较评估。
contributions_en: Co-developed the model and training framework, and curated datasets for computational analysis.
Conducted analyses and benchmarking, prepared figures, and contributed to drafting the manuscript.
contributions_zh: 共同设计并实现模型及训练框架，整理用于计算分析的数据集。
承担计算分析、基准评测、图表制作与论文初稿撰写。
research_projects.output_en: Manuscript under revision at Cell Reports Methods; research code is publicly available.
research_projects.output_zh: 相关稿件正在Cell Reports Methods返修；研究代码已公开。

research_projects.meta_zh: 基础模型 · 病毒基因组学 · KDD 2026
research_projects.summary_en: ViroBench is a collaborative benchmark study of nucleotide foundation models on viral genomics tasks. It examines the use of learned sequence representations in this research setting, with an emphasis on model comparison and evaluation.
research_projects.summary_zh: ViroBench是一项面向病毒基因组学任务的核酸基础模型评测研究，关注学习得到的序列表征在相关研究场景中的应用，以及模型的比较与评估。
contributions_en: Contributed to the collaborative study as a co-author, extending my research experience in foundation-model evaluation and computational virology.
contributions_zh: 作为合作作者参与该项研究，积累核酸基础模型评测与计算病毒学的交叉研究经验。
research_projects.output_en: Published in the proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining, 2026.
research_projects.output_zh: 研究成果发表于第32届ACM SIGKDD国际会议论文集（2026）。

research_projects.summary_zh: 该合作项目结合流行病学观测与系统发育信息研究疫情动态，将数据分析、计算建模与传染病流行病学问题相联系。

在合作团队中承担计算分析与方法研究相关工作。

承担生物信息学分析，并参与团队对研究结果的综合解读。

research_projects.name_zh: 单细胞RNA测序自动化分析流程
research_projects.summary_en: This project connects upstream sequencing-data processing with downstream single-cell analysis. The work focuses on organizing analysis steps into configurable workflows that can be used within an automated analysis platform.

Collaborated with IT colleagues to deploy the workflows on an automated analysis platform.

research_projects.name_zh: 基于RNA测序的白血病分子分型
research_projects.meta_zh: 转录组学 · 分子分类
research_projects.summary_en: This project studies expression-based molecular classification of leukemia. It uses RNA-seq expression profiles to support subtype modeling and the interpretation of transcriptomic differences between leukemia groups.
research_projects.summary_zh: 该项目研究基于基因表达的白血病分子分类，利用RNA测序表达谱开展亚型建模，并辅助理解不同白血病类别的转录组差异。

Framed the analysis around subtype differences relevant to clinical characteristics and prognosis.
contributions_zh: 基于表达数据开发白血病分子亚型预测模型。
围绕不同亚型的临床特征与预后差异组织分析问题。
research_projects.output_en: RNA-seq analysis and molecular-subtyping code are available in the project repository.
research_projects.output_zh: 相关RNA测序分析与分子分型代码整理于项目仓库。
